properties.notes: The site is allocated for housing development in the Sites and Housing Plan adopted in February 2013. The site is also allocated in the emerging Local Plan 2036, which is currently undergoing an examination in public (consultation on proposed modifications following hearings). The site includes a listed building. This site is partially greenfield and partially brownfield (as shown on the site location plan). The land area in hectares given on this Register relates to the brownfield part of the site only. The capacity of this site has been calculated based on development being focused on the existing built footprint.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
